original_finding_content.raw_text:
**What:** User reports 5 months without any sales on Hotmart.  
**Verbatim snippet:** "Aspecto positivo que veo q mucha gente gana mucho dinero Aspecto negativo que no puedo creer que llevo mas de 5 meses y no he vendido nada"  
**Source:** https://es.trustpilot.com/review/hotmart.com?page=2  
**source_type:** buyer_review  
**Date:** 27 marzo 2026  
**Notes:** Reviewer "José," location AR (Argentina). Degraded from Part 1: seller identity cannot be fixed — "no he vendido nada" could indicate producer or affiliate. Text does not specify role. Per rule 6: degrade to could_not_verify.
